result.title: Preserving Pretrained CFG Structure in RL for Diffusion Models with Conditional Contrast Regularization
result.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important component in the post-training of diffusion models. In practice, however, standard RL often improves the target reward without reliably preserving holistic generation quality, leading to unstable reward-quality trade-offs that we view as a form of reward hacking. Since Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is known to improve visual clarity, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality in generation, we investigate whether its underlying structure can serve as a useful prior during RL. We present a unified geometric view that interprets both CFG and RL as correction vectors in a common prediction space, and identify the projection of the RL-induced correction onto the pretrained CFG correction as a useful diagnostic of quality-related structural preservation. Geometric analysis and rotation intervention further show that the pretrained CFG direction carries information useful for generation quality that reward-driven RL updates do not necessarily preserve. Based on this insight, we propose Conditional Contrast Regularization (CCR), which uses the frozen reference model's conditional contrast as a local structural prior during RL. Experiments across multiple reward settings and backbones show that CCR more consistently preserves generation quality while maintaining competitive reward, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than standard RL and generic regularization methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散模型 RL 后训练中奖励提升与生成质量之间的失衡问题，从几何视角将 CFG 与 RL 都解释为预测空间中的修正向量，提出以冻结参考模型的条件对比作为局部结构先验的条件对比正则（CCR），在多种奖励设置与骨干上改善奖励—质量权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用「RL 修正向量在预训练 CFG 方向上的投影」诊断训练是否保留原有结构，并据此施加正则，可能可供核查 LVR 中奖励或轨迹训练是否保持视觉与推理相关表征结构；论文本身并非多模态推理工作。
